channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: The Gaslighting of Hannah Pettey
item.description: After a young woman nearly dies from poisoning, investigators look into the two people she trusted most. "48 Hours" correspondent Anne-Marie Green reports.

item.title: Volcanic eruptions in Indonesia lead to cancellation of hundreds of flights at major airport
item.description: Over 500 flight operations were canceled as a result of the eruption and ash emissions.

item.title: Witkoff and Kushner hold talks with Putin on Ukraine conflict
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin met with U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner for three hours on Saturday to discuss the war in Ukraine.

item.title: Iran live updates: US strikes oil tankers; Tehran claims attacks on US-linked vessels
item.description: The Strait of Hormuz continues to be the main flashpoint in the ongoing conflict.
